description:
**Surfaced 2026-05-16** during Arc-25 drift apply to three consumer workspaces (railway--l7o, ariadne--kwo, s4--3jp). The apply caught a structural gap in the existing skill: check.sh / apply.sh are deployed-file-centric (iterate what's in workspace .claude/ and ask "did it drift?"). install.sh is source-centric (iterate what substrate thinks should be deployed and write it). When the substrate ADDS a new file (new skill, new CAPTAIN, new template), check.sh reports CURRENT for the workspace even though the workspace is missing the upstream addition. The verdict lies.

Today's drift apply only caught the new credential-discipline skill because the prior POLYBIUS encoded the gap explicitly in each pointer ticket ("5 files + 1 new skill"). Without that pointer, I'd have run apply.sh, seen CURRENT, closed the tickets, and shipped three workspaces missing the new skill. The detection cliff is real; the safety today depended on a written work-around that future arcs might forget.

## Problem

Three drift types matter; check.sh handles only one:

| Type | Definition | Today |
|---|---|---|
| **DRIFTED** | File exists in both source and workspace; content differs | check.sh handles ✓ |
| **MISSING** | File exists in source; workspace doesn't have it | check.sh blind ✗ |
| **OBSOLETE** | File exists in workspace; source dropped it (e.g., Arc 25 deleted railway-access from user-tier) | check.sh blind ✗ |

Plus: at apply time, the operator needs to know whether the workspace's .claude/ has uncommitted local edits (which apply.sh --yes will auto-commit-then-overwrite — recoverable via git but the deployed file then reflects upstream, semantically destructive if the local edit was intentional). Today this is a manual pre-flight via git status; needs to be baked into detection.

## Proposed scope (Option B — preserve the seam)

Extend check.sh to detect all three categories + uncommitted-state pre-flight. apply.sh stays narrow (DRIFTED only). install.sh handles MISSING (always idempotent) + OBSOLETE (via --prune-obsolete, which already exists). check.sh output explicitly names which tool to run for each category so the operator routes correctly. apply.sh does NOT grow --add-missing or --remove-obsolete; that would duplicate install.sh's source-side deploy/prune lists, which is the coupling the existing skill explicitly designed around (see apply_substitutions cite-comment pattern at check.sh / apply.sh today).

## Deliverables

1. **check.sh — MISSING detection.** Parse source-side SKILL_NAMES from install.sh; enumerate substrate/CAPTAIN_*.md; enumerate substrate/templates/*.md. For each, report MISSING if absent from workspace .claude/ at the substituted destination path. Cite-comment at the parse site pointing back to install.sh lines (same mitigation pattern as apply_substitutions today).
2. **check.sh — OBSOLETE detection.** Enumerate workspace .claude/ files matching substrate-deployable patterns (.claude/skills/*/, .claude/agents/CAPTAIN_*.md, .claude/templates/*.md, .claude/MAJOR_*.md, .claude/operating-disciplines.md). For each, report OBSOLETE if not in source set.
3. **check.sh — uncommitted-state surfacing.** Per workspace, report count of uncommitted .claude/ changes (modified + untracked, excluding .substrate-last-check). Surface as a pre-flight warning at apply time.
4. **check.sh — output format.** Per workspace, per category, with explicit guidance:
       railway_stoa            DRIFTED + MISSING (3 drifted, 1 missing, 0 obsolete; 0 uncommitted)
         DRIFTED:
           - .claude/operating-disciplines.md     (+101 lines)
         MISSING:
           - .claude/skills/credential-discipline/   (new in source)
         Run apply.sh for drift; run install.sh for missing.
5. **SKILL.md doc update.** Document the three categories, the seam (apply.sh narrow, install.sh handles add/prune), and the operator routing. Update 'How to invoke' section.
6. **apply.sh — unchanged in behavior.** Verify it still works post-check.sh changes (no regression in DRIFTED-only flow).
7. **install.sh — no changes.** --prune-obsolete already exists; this arc surfaces it from check.sh output rather than expanding it.

## Acceptance (probes)

- check.sh against a workspace with a deleted-upstream skill reports OBSOLETE (synthetic test: drop a stub .claude/skills/fake-deleted/ into a test workspace; verify check.sh flags it)
- check.sh against a workspace missing an upstream-new skill reports MISSING (test: temporarily add a skill to SKILL_NAMES and check a workspace; verify check.sh flags it)
- check.sh against a workspace with uncommitted .claude/ changes reports the count
- check.sh output names which tool to run for each category
- check.sh exit code stays 0 in all cases (drift is informational, never failure)
- Existing DRIFTED behavior byte-equal to current
- apply.sh DRIFTED-only flow byte-equal to current (no regression)

## Out of scope (do NOT do in this arc)

- User-tier check support (covered by stoa--bj5; orthogonal axis)
- Auto-discovery of workspaces (Option Small ratified explicit registry)
- Four-category drift classification (locally-modified × upstream-advanced) — Option Small ratified the simpler model; revisiting this is its own arc, not Option B
- apply.sh --add-missing / --remove-obsolete (the source-side coupling Option B explicitly avoids)
- consumer-workspaces.txt format change

## Self-named honest gaps Option B leaves on PRINCIPAL's plate

Surfaced during the option discussion 2026-05-16:
- Local-vs-upstream attribution of drift remains punted (Option Small)
- OBSOLETE removal stays PRINCIPAL-gated (destructive)
- DRIFTED on workspaces with uncommitted local edits stays PRINCIPAL-gated (judgment call)
- These are deliberate — Option B closes the SILENT-CURRENT cliff (worst failure mode) without taking on Option Small's rejected complexity. Closing the remaining 15-20% requires reopening Option Small, which is its own arc.

## Cross-refs

- stoa--lyh — original substrate-update-check skill design (Option Small ratified)
- railway--l7o, ariadne--kwo, s4--3jp — Arc-25 drift apply tickets (closed today) that surfaced the gap
- the-stoa commit 71ea092 — current substrate HEAD; b879803 — sector-4 added to registry
- HANDOFF_POLYBIUS_2026-05-16.md — engagement context

## Honest scope estimate

Smaller than Arc 25. Single skill, three coherent extensions. ~1-2 files edited (check.sh, SKILL.md). One DAEDALUS design + one ADA build + one VERA verify pass; CATO if scope grows. ARGUS pass before ADA dispatches given the SKILL_NAMES parsing coupling is a real risk vector.
